why_this_file_exists: THIRD CONSECUTIVE PACK REGRESSION, to the same parent. The slice-65 pack is again the SLICE-61 tree: everything from slices 62, 63 AND 64 is absent, the three digest probes all read slice-61, and the baseline suite is identical to slice 64's down to the failing test names. Three occurrences is a PATTERN, not an incident: the pack is being built from a fixed parent rather than from the previous deliverable. EDGE.md §48a.

apparatus.why: The prefix invariant, the forward-window helpers and the slice 62-64 tools are what make a forward segment computable at all. Restored byte-identically, not re-implemented.

tests/test_slice55_data_eligibility.py.why: The manifest enumeration went red — which is exactly what slice 64 built it to do. The signal read RE-BROADCAST, not repaired: ETH's and SOL's four files are byte-identical to slice 64's and their declared counts moved anyway, tracking BTC's. Re-pinned to the new values. EDGE.md §48a.
tests/test_slice55_data_eligibility.py.strength: STRICTLY STRONGER. Two checks were added that assert the SHAPE of the defect rather than its values — all three symbols declaring one count while the files hold three, and the declared counts moving while the files do not — so the next regeneration is caught even before anyone compares numbers, and the 'systematic vs one-off' question is answered by a test.

tests/test_slice64_window_grew.py.why: Four tests asserted LIVE ABSOLUTES — `appended_rows == 2`, a hard-coded 2026-08-12, slice-64 row counts against today's disk — and expired when a third bar arrived. §47f named this exact mistake and the same file then made it, which is worth recording rather than quietly fixing. A fifth amendment followed: `test_every_restored_file_matches_its_recorded_digest` re-verified the restored APPARATUS against live files, which slice 65 legitimately amended — the same amendment slice 64 made to slice 63's file, one level up. Recurrence at two consecutive levels is the sign it should be a RULE rather than a repair, so it is now stated generally in that test: EACH SLICE'S RESTORATION MANIFEST OWNS THE LIVE APPARATUS; EVERY EARLIER ONE OWNS ONLY ITS FROZEN RECORDS.
tests/test_slice64_window_grew.py.strength: Each dated claim now asserts against slice 64's FROZEN artefact and each live claim asserts direction of travel. `test_no_bar_for_the_current_utc_day_is_present` is the clearest gain: it computes today from the clock instead of hard-coding a date, so it states the real rule — an unclosed bar is never on disk — and cannot expire.

apparatus.amendment_rule: A TEST is a living document; a dated ARTEFACT is not. Every amendment carries both digests, a reason and an argument for why the new form is stronger, and a test refuses any digest change this manifest does not name.
